551 source rows were a second review on the same order and were collapsed to one (latest kept); 202 orders had conflicting scores.
33 geolocation coordinates were outside Brazil and were moved to data/quarantine/ (ZIP kept, centroid from valid rows).
775 orders have no line items: item_revenue is NULL for them, so GMV built on fact_order_item omits them by construction.
8 orders are marked 'delivered' with no delivery timestamp - excluded from delivery-delay metrics (NULL kept).

1,382 orders have a non-monotonic date sequence (approval / carrier / delivery out of order). They are kept and flagged with has_impossible_date_sequence; an audit copy is in data/quarantine/quarantine_invalid_dates.csv.
11 payment rows have a non-positive value or instalment count; kept and flagged, excluded from payment-mix rates.
13 product rows belong to a category with no English translation (English label left NULL, not guessed).
610 products had no category and were tagged 'unknown' so they survive group-by and joins.
